title: Bakuchiol Ameliorates Glucocorticoid-Induced Osteoporosis by Enhancing Osteoblast Differentiation via Targeting FAT4 to Activate YAP1.
authors: Wang, Hengjun; Zhou, Tingting; Zhao, Yunchao; Meng, Zhengxin; Sun, Zhiqiang; Zhou, Hao; Liu, Huan; Du, Changyu; Lv, Shuquan; Zhao, Jianyong; Zhang, Zhongyong; Cui, Huantian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药补骨脂酚通过靶向FAT4激活YAP1改善糖皮质激素性骨质疏松，虽涉及分子对接和转录因子YAP1，但核心是成骨分化药理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Psoralea corylifolia Linn. exhibits osteogenic effects; however, the mechanism by which its active component Bakuchiol (BAK) alleviates glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis (GIOP) remains unclear. We aim to investigate BAK's therapeutic effects and potential mechanisms in GIOP. We treated GIOP mice with BAK. We evaluated BAK's therapeutic efficacy using micro-CT and histopathological staining. We performed transcriptomic analysis and identified significantly enriched GO pathways. We then used biochemical assays and Western blotting to examine the effects of BAK on osteogenic differentiation-related signaling factors in GIOP mice. We conducted in vitro experiments using osteoblasts. We employed RT-qPCR, Western blot, ALP & ARS staining, immunofluorescence and dual-luciferase reporter assays to assess BAK's influence on signaling pathways related to osteoblast differentiation. We used molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) to confirm the direct binding interaction between BAK and FAT4. Finally, we silenced Fat4 to validate that BAK exerts its anti-GIOP effects by activating YAP1 through FAT4. BAK treatment significantly enhanced bone quality and strength in GIOP mice, and mitigated femoral pathological damage. BAK upregulated key osteoblast differentiation-related transcription factors and enhanced serum alkaline phosphatase activity. Western blot confirmed that BAK increased protein levels of YAP1 while reducing levels of FAT4 and DCHS1. In vitro, BAK similarly promoted osteoblast differentiation and activated YAP1 expression and Runx2 transcription. Molecular docking, CETSA and DARTS analyses demonstrated that BAK directly binds to FAT4. Silencing Fat4 abolished the pro-osteogenic effects of BAK. BAK likely exerts its therapeutic effects in GIOP by targeting FAT4, activating YAP1 and promoting osteoblast differentiation.
abstract_zh: 补骨脂（Psoralea corylifolia Linn.）具有成骨作用；然而，其活性成分补骨脂酚（Bakuchiol, BAK）缓解糖皮质激素诱导的骨质疏松症（glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis, GIOP）的机制尚不清楚。我们旨在研究BAK在GIOP中的治疗效果及潜在机制。我们用BAK处理GIOP小鼠。我们使用micro-CT和组织病理学染色评估BAK的治疗效果。我们进行了转录组分析，并鉴定了显著富集的GO通路。随后，我们使用生化检测和Western blotting检查BAK对GIOP小鼠成骨分化相关信号因子的影响。我们使用成骨细胞进行了体外实验。我们采用RT-qPCR、Western blot、ALP和ARS染色、免疫荧光及双荧光素酶报告基因实验评估BAK对成骨细胞分化相关信号通路的影响。我们使用分子对接、细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay, CETSA）和药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（drug affinity responsive target stability, DARTS）确认BAK与FAT4之间的直接结合相互作用。最后，我们沉默Fat4以验证BAK通过FAT4激活YAP1发挥其抗GIOP作用。BAK处理显著增强了GIOP小鼠的骨质量和强度，并减轻了股骨病理损伤。BAK上调了关键成骨细胞分化相关转录因子，并增强了血清碱性磷酸酶活性。Western blot证实BAK增加了YAP1蛋白水平，同时降低了FAT4和DCHS1水平。在体外，BAK同样促进了成骨细胞分化，并激活了YAP1表达和Runx2转录。分子对接、CETSA和DARTS分析表明BAK直接结合FAT4。沉默Fat4消除了BAK的促成骨效应。BAK可能通过靶向FAT4、激活YAP1并促进成骨细胞分化，在GIOP中发挥其治疗作用。
